newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai opens China's first regional Internet.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai opens China's first regional Internet.

text.p: Shanghai has opened China's first regional Internet, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.

The Shanghai Internet was formed by combining five existing sub-networks and users will be able to share information on education, science, medicine, culture, markets, government policies and regulations and other topics, it said.
Xinhua quoted experts as saying the new system showed that Shanghai has made a significant step forward in establishing itself as an international information harbour.
